dteday.reason: same information as yr, mnth and weekday

season.reason: 1 to 4 are season labels, not amounts

hr.reason: demand peaks at the morning and evening rush hours instead of rising in a straight line

weathersit.reason: 1 to 4 are weather types, not amounts

casual.reason: part of the target: casual + registered = cnt

registered.reason: part of the target: casual + registered = cnt

spec.name: Bike Sharing
spec.title: What drives hourly bike rentals?
spec.lede: Capital Bikeshare, Washington D.C., 2011 and 2012: predict the rentals in an hour (cnt) from the hour of day, season, weather and calendar. casual and registered are dropped because they add up to cnt, and the hour is one-hot encoded because demand peaks at rush hour instead of rising in a straight line.

descriptions.holiday: 1 if the day is a public holiday
descriptions.weekday: day of the week, 0 = Sunday to 6 = Saturday
descriptions.workingday: 1 if the day is neither a weekend nor a holiday
descriptions.weathersit: weather type: 1 clear, 2 mist or cloud, 3 light rain or snow, 4 heavy rain, ice or fog
descriptions.cnt: rentals in the hour, casual plus registered users

zipcode.reason: ZIP code is a location label, not a quantity

spec.name: King County houses
spec.title: What sets a house price in King County?
spec.lede: Home sales in King County, Washington (the Seattle area), May 2014 to May 2015: predict the sale price from size, build quality, location and age. id is dropped, the sale date becomes year and month, ZIP code is treated as a label, and sqft_above is dropped because sqft_living = sqft_above + sqft_basement.

descriptions.bathrooms: number of bathrooms; 0.5 is a toilet without a shower
descriptions.waterfront: 1 if the house overlooks the waterfront
descriptions.grade: construction and design quality, 1 to 13 (King County grading)
descriptions.sqft_above: living space above ground, sq ft
descriptions.sqft_basement: living space below ground, sq ft
descriptions.yr_renovated: year of the last renovation, 0 if never
descriptions.sqft_living15: average living space of the 15 nearest houses, sq ft
descriptions.sqft_lot15: average land area of the 15 nearest houses, sq ft
